plugins.description: Videos made with code by your coding agent: reels with word-by-word captions, voice-over, music cut on the beat, before/after wipes and end cards, plus animations drawn frame by frame (kinetic type, animated ads, charts, 3D products, physics). 9:16, 16:9 and 1:1.
